@[simp]
theorem smul_eq_zero : c • x = 0 ↔ c = 0 ∨ x = 0 :=
  ⟨eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_smul_eq_zero, fun h =>
    h.elim (fun h => h.symm ▸ zero_smul R x) fun h => h.symm ▸ smul_zero c⟩

C1_dependencies.name: map_smul
C1_dependencies.content:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem map_smul {F M X Y : Type*} [SMul M X] [SMul M Y]
    [FunLike F X Y] [MulActionHomClass F M X Y]
    (f : F) (c : M) (x : X) : f (c • x) = c • f x :=
  map_smulₛₗ f c x

lemma superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_symm (φ φ' : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
    [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF φ']ₛca =
    (- 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φ')) • [ofCrAnOpF φ', ofCrAnOpF φ]ₛca := by
  rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
  rw [smul_sub]
  simp only [instCommGroup.eq_1, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, neg_smul, sub_neg_eq_add]
  rw [smul_smul]
  conv_rhs =>
    rhs
    rw [exchangeSign_symm, exchangeSign_mul_self]
  simp only [one_smul]
  abel

C1_dependencies.name: FieldSpecification.FieldOpFreeAlgebra.ofCrAnOpF
C1_dependencies.content:
/-- For a field specification `𝓕`, and a element `φ` of `𝓕.CrAnFieldOp`,
  `ofCrAnOpF φ` is defined as the element of `𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra` formed by `φ`. -/
def ofCrAnOpF (φ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) : FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕 :=
  FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ φ
